note: The one list of the runner's verbs and options. host.gd's OPTIONS table must equal it (a selftest case checks that); the Foreman reads it instead of keeping a copy.
modes_note: N2. World modes of the host (kernel/world/). They are not verify verbs: no tl.verify/1 report, no --pack, no level; they print tl.world/1 lines. host.gd's MODE_OPTIONS table must equal this list (the same selftest case). tools/world.sh is the wrapper.

frames.note: ticks of each pack's own clock; one value or one per pack

at.note: x:y:z per pack: where the pack stands in the world

spacing.note: pack i stands at (i * spacing, 0, 0) when --at is not given

every.note: the pack gets one world tick in N

pause.note: <pack index|all>:<from world tick>:<ticks>, several separated by ;

mode.note: smoke (nobody plays) or bot (each pack's first test plays it)

space.note: own (one physics space per pack) or shared (the default space; a measurement control)

trace.note: record a state hash every N pack ticks

hold.note: world ticks to keep running after every pack has finished (all switched off)

state.note: include each pack's _pack_state in its line

out.note: also write the lines to this file

only.note: run only the tests whose name contains this
